# Party: party (PARTY)

A political party that won seats in the lower chamber at the most recent election, with the chamber's full result. One row per party, keyed by PARTY_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `civic-store` (table `<root>/civic/party/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/world-economy/samples/party.jsonl`, 282 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/world-economy/samples/party.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `PARTY_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 282 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

  "PARTY_ID": "PARTY-ARG-01",

    {

    "… 2 more elements of the same shape"

    "SOURCE": "CIA, The World Factbook (factbook.json mirror, CC0)",

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PARTY_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^PARTY-` | `"PARTY-ARG-01"` |
| `NAME` | string | optional (filled in over 99% of rows) | The party's name as the CIA World Factbook lists it in the election result. | — | `"Union for the Homeland (UP)"` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | required | The country the party competes in. | — | `"Argentina"` |
| `SEATS` | integer | required | The seats the party won in the chamber at the most recent election. | — | `48` |
| `SEAT_SHARE` | number | required | The party's seats as a share of the seats the Factbook lists. | unit: % of seats | `37.5` |
| `CHAMBER` | string | required | The legislative chamber the result is for. | — | `"Chamber of Deputies (Cámara de Diputados)"` |
| `RANK` | integer | required | The party's rank by seats won in the chamber (1 = most). | — | `1` |
| `TOTAL_SEATS` | integer | required | The total seats in the chamber. | — | `128` |
| `ELECTION_DATE` | string | required | When the most recent election was held, as published. | — | `"10/22/2023"` |
| `RESULTS` | array of objects | required | The whole election's seats by party, one element per party: PARTY, SEATS and SHARE (% of seats). | — | [4 objects] |
| `RESULTS[].PARTY` | string | optional (filled in over 99% of `RESULTS[]` entries) | A party or group in the chamber. | — | `"Union for the Homeland (UP)"` |
| `RESULTS[].SEATS` | integer | required | The seats it won. | — | `48` |
| `RESULTS[].SHARE` | number | required | The party's share of the chamber's seats. | unit: percent, in points | `37.5` |
| `ELECTION` | string | required | The election the party won seats at: an id of the election kind (ELEC-<ISO3>-LOW). | pattern `^ELEC-`; links to `election` | `"ELEC-ARG-LOW"` |

| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The named dataset and its vintage (the release the numbers come from). | — | `"The World Factbook (mirror commit 144d6977b2)"` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the data was downloaded by tools/realdata. | — | `"2026-10-10"` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The terms under which the source allows reuse; attribution is required. | — | `"Public domain (U.S. Government work); the factbook.json mi…` |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | — | `"Central Intelligence Agency, The World Factbook (public do…` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The web page of the dataset. | — | `"https://www.cia.gov/the-world-factbook/"` |
| `_meta` | object | optional (filled in every row) | The generator's provenance stamp, one object; optional, carried through in the stored document and not read by Drishti (the contracts leave it out). A bank's extract may omit it. | — | {…} |
| `_meta.source` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source system or public source the record was built from (sec-edgar, gleif, …). | — | `"CIA, The World Factbook (factbook.json mirror, CC0)"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 282 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `PARTY_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `PARTY_ID`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `SEATS`, `SEAT_SHARE`, `CHAMBER`, `RANK`, `TOTAL_SEATS`, `ELECTION_DATE`, `RESULTS`, `ELECTION`, `JURISDICTION`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `PARTY_ID` per snapshot.
- `PARTY_ID` matches `^PARTY-`.
